findings.title: No test checks that an unchanged relocate shows no toast
findings.body:
The new flag is asserted only at the start of its path, in `relocate.test.ts:158`. Nothing checks the two steps that make the fix visible to the user:
- `relocateFolder` copying `unchanged` into the IPC result (`index.ts:349`);
- `onRelocated` returning before `showToast`.

The Settings tests only check the case where the toast does appear (`workspaces-settings.test.tsx:262` and `:282`). If either step stopped passing the flag along, the "now points to the new folder" toast would come back and no test would fail.

Suggested test: in `workspaces-settings.test.tsx`, mock `relocate` to resolve `{ ok: true, workspace, unchanged: true }` and assert that `showToast` is not called.

contracts.action: Picking the folder the workspace already points at in "Change folder…" returns `unchanged: true`, and the renderer then skips the "now points" toast
contracts.equivalent_path: A real relocate: `registry.relocate`, or `relocateActive` for the active workspace, then `relocateFolder` runs the probe, refreshes titles, broadcasts and returns the view
contracts.before_after: `checkRelocate` and `relocateRefusal` still run before the early return. `relocateFolder` still runs `availability` (which rewrites an identity deleted by hand), `refreshTitles` and `broadcastState`, the same as a real relocate. The only difference is the flag in the result.
contracts.visible_effect: `onRelocated` in the context returns early, so neither the dialog nor Settings shows a toast. The dialog stays open, as it does after a real relocate.
contracts.failure_mode: The failure path is unchanged: when the IPC call rejects, the context shows `relocateUncertain`. A refusal still reaches `relocateRefusalMessage`.

contracts.action: An offline edit of a `pendingInit` workspace keeps `pendingInit` set when the folder was not written
contracts.equivalent_path: The `availability` probe clears `pendingInit` only after it writes or finds an identity, and `add` clears it only when it relocates
contracts.before_after: When the folder comes back, the no-identity branch of the probe writes `identity.json` with the edited name and color, then clears `pendingInit` and `pendingIdentity`. `checkRelocate` keeps accepting a moved folder that has Kaipu items and no identity while `pendingInit` is set.
contracts.visible_effect: "Change folder…" on that workspace now accepts the remounted folder instead of refusing it as `has-items-no-identity`.
contracts.failure_mode: If the registry write fails, `update` rolls back and `edit` returns `not-writable`. Nothing was written to the folder in this branch, so there is nothing to undo.

Confirmed: `checkRelocate` accepts a folder with items and no identity for a `pendingInit` entry (registry.ts:855). This round also keeps `pendingInit` after an offline edit (registry.ts:634), with a test. Leaving the adoption case as a follow-up is reasonable.

Not in this round's files. Accepting the removal from 64db30b0.

structuredOutput.summary: This round fixes two problems. Picking the folder a workspace already uses no longer shows a misleading toast, and an offline edit no longer clears `pendingInit`. Both work correctly. The one gap is tests: nothing checks that the `unchanged` flag reaches the renderer or that the toast is then skipped. All 14 earlier threads are addressed.
